data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'legomai', meaning 'to speak, to recount, to reason'. In the Bible, Legra could represent obedience, lawfulness, or the act of speaking or recounting God's word. The name Legra carries the meaning “Lawful, obedient” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Legra usually hope their child will grow to embody lawful, obedient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
